regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, keywords, and SI statement
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate NaI/TBSCl migrative-oxidation claim inspected. The article states online SI availability, but workspace mapping leaves SI association unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and upper Scheme 1 arrow
regions.finding: The NaI/TMSCl/H2O conversion of generic allylic alcohols to allylic iodides is explicitly previous Ishii work and is classified as a literature example, not a current experiment.
The generic current 4-EWG-2,3-allenol to 2(E)-enal transformation is classified as a general scheme; experiment-specific results are assigned to Table 1/2 rows.

regions.region: page 1 Results and Discussion initial observation
regions.finding: The initial MeCN/TMSCl observation and solvent discussion map to Table 1 entries 1–6 on page 2. No duplicate narrative-only experiment was created.

unresolved: The prior-work and current generic arrows contain R groups and do not define unique structures or yields.
The page-1 initial-observation prose does not give row-specific substrate scale or isolated mass.

regions.region: page 2 upper Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–13, and footnotes a–j
regions.finding: Thirteen independent optimization conditions were retained with row-specific solvent, chlorosilane identity/loading, iodide identity/loading, time, NMR yield or complicated outcome, selectivity marker, no-reagent controls, and 97% recovery in entry 7. The footnote's 0.1 or 0.15 mmol scale is not mapped to rows and remains unresolved.

The prose identifies entry 13 as the standard condition. Entry 13 is merged with Table 2 entry 1 because both describe 1a under the same standard conditions with the same 70% isolated result; 72% NMR and 70% isolated yields remain distinct.
The substituent-by-substituent discussion maps to the fourteen Table 2 experiments shown on page 3. All rows remain separate except the explicit Table 1 entry 13/Table 2 entry 1 cross-listing.
The 1p complicated control and 1q-to-E-2q 55% experiment use the standard conditions and continue as Scheme 2 on page 4.

unresolved: Table 1 does not map 0.1 versus 0.15 mmol to individual rows.
Table 2 omits scale, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 header, entries 1–14, and footnote a
regions.finding: Fourteen substrate-scope experiments were reconciled with standard 2.0-equiv NaI/1.5-equiv TBSCl, MeCN 0.1 M, room temperature, 2 h, isolated yields, and crude-1H-NMR (E,Z)/(Z,Z) ratios. Entry 1 is merged with Table 1 entry 13; entries 2–14 remain distinct.

regions.region: page 3 center Figure 1 formation arrow and ORTEP
regions.finding: Condensation of (E,Z)-2n with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine/H2SO4 to (E,Z)-4a is one partial experiment. ORTEP characterization supports configuration and is not a second preparation.
The prose confirms the 1p complicated outcome, the 1q-to-E-2q 55% experiment, and subsequent DNPH formation of E-4b; the full arrows appear on page 4 and are linked rather than duplicated.
The 5a control gives 8a (27%), 7a (47%), and 6a (6%) by crude 1H NMR. This maps to one multi-product experiment plus a separate proposed Int-A/Int-B mechanism on page 4.

unresolved: The two hydrazone arrows omit scale, quantities, solvent, time, purification, mass, and yield on pages 1–6.

regions.finding: Three distinct arrows were retained: 1p gives a complicated mixture under standard conditions; 1q gives E-2q in 55%; E-2q undergoes DNPH/H2SO4 condensation to E-4b. The crystal drawing is characterization only.
The single 5a experiment has three product-specific crude-NMR yields (8a 27%, 7a 47%, 6a 6%). Int-A/Int-B and their competing eliminations are classified separately as mechanism.

Z-1o with 4 equiv NaI/3 equiv TBSCl in MeCN at room temperature gives 10a in 68%; expected 2o and other cyclization product 9a are explicitly not detected in the crude mixture. Int-C/Int-D are a separate proposed mechanism.

The text reports three controls shown on page 5: Z-11a/H2O to 2a (70% isolated), Z-1a-D isotope transfer, and Z-1a/D2O labeling. These records use cross-page evidence rather than duplicate narrative records.
The proposed HI/H+-mediated migration mechanism continues as Scheme 6 on page 5 and is classified as mechanism, not preparations of 11a-D or M1/M2.

unresolved: Scheme 4 does not report reaction time, scale, detection limit, isolated mass, or yield basis on pages 1–6.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed and not independently observed.

regions.finding: Three distinct experiments were retained with all displayed equivalents, room temperature/2 h conditions, 70%/63%/69% outcomes, and product-specific isotope contents including 0%, <5%, 62%, 63%, and 84% values.
11a-D, M1, M2, and M2-D are proposed intermediates in the authors' HI/H+/D+ migration model and are represented as one mechanism record, not isolated experiments.
Narrative interpretation of proton exchange, kinetic isotope effect, and thermodynamic product stability supports the Scheme 5/6 records. Conclusions add no new experiment, row, or outcome.

unresolved: The isotope-measurement methods and most operational workups/purifications are not reported on pages 1–6.
Isotope placement is retained in labels/outcomes and not asserted in SMILES.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left Experimental Section materials and analytical methods
regions.finding: Shared solvent drying, commercial-source, and spectroscopy conventions were inspected as materials context; they are not independent reaction experiments.

regions.finding: The 1aa/m-tolylmagnesium bromide addition was retained with exact scale, 5 min addition, 2 h reaction, aqueous workup, chromatography, 0.9684 g, and 75% isolated yield.

regions.finding: The separate 1aa/p-bromophenylmagnesium bromide experiment was retained with exact quantities, displayed 3 min plus 2.25 h timing, petroleum ether/DCM purification, 0.6448 g, and 44% isolated yield.
